title: state.json
description: Runtime state written by CrossPointState (src/CrossPointState.cpp) to /.crosspoint/state.json. Every key is optional; missing keys load as their defaults.

recentRing.description: Ring buffer of the last SLEEP_RECENT_COUNT (16) sleep image indices. Extra entries are ignored on load.

ringPos.description: Next write slot in the ring buffer. Out-of-range values are reduced modulo 16.

ringFill.description: Number of valid ring entries. Clamped to the array length on load.

openEpubPath.description: SD path of the book open when the device last slept; empty when none.

lastSleepImage.description: Legacy single last sleep image index. Read only when recentSleepFill is 0, then pushed into recentSleepImages; 255 means none.
